states.basis: Retained public Terrarium heights and 16641-value native grid. Y0 is decoded 2098.7457 m anchor working datum. Rigid -25.47 m architectural shift gives 12.53 m plateau intercept, constrained by ruin bases, reservoir floors and approach. Cliff/ledge feet extend below sampled grade; local plateau has real reservoir holes above host terrain. Exact geology, floors and route levels remain unverified.

limits: Numeric Terrarium tile spacing and 4 m review grid do not establish native DEM resolution or vertical accuracy. Small rocky crest, caves and archaeological cuts are smoothed.
A rigid architectural translation is chosen to clear retained terrain at mapped ruin bases, cut-reservoir floors and the interpreted approach route. This is not a measured archaeological floor datum.
The retained sloping plateau and local cliff shell belong to this exterior reconstruction. Cliff bottoms extend below sampled host terrain, without including the full mountain.
All five cut-reservoir floors remain above retained host heights, avoiding a whole-precinct terrain cutout. Compatibility with other terrain vintages/products remains unverified.
Exact geological flutes, broken-wall profiles, reservoir depths and positions, cave passages and modern route elevations require a surveyed archaeological model.

inspection.notes: Actually inspected all 25 final grade images. Local cliff and ledge meet the retained host slope, roofless rooms and all five cut reservoirs stay open. Reservoir floors retain an interpreted muted green tint, not a measured water/vegetation state. Coarse terrain and reconstructed rock facets do not establish exact archaeological elevations or geology.
